description: Source code for a program that performs USB device reset by bus/device number, vendor/product ID, or product name, including functions for device enumeration and reset via ioctl.

methods.name: sysfs_attr
methods.description: Reads a specific attribute file for a USB device from sysfs.

methods.name: parse_devlist
methods.description: Parses the device list directory to find USB device entries.

methods.name: list_devices
methods.description: Lists all connected USB devices with their details.

methods.name: find_device
methods.description: Finds a USB device matching bus/device numbers, vendor/product IDs, or product name.

methods.name: reset_device
methods.description: Performs a reset on the specified USB device using ioctl.
